text: Pick the age, pick the gender. Meta still decides who sees your ad. It reads your creative, not your targeting.
So here's what we do. We call it the three angle method.
One, a problem ad: show the pain your customer already feels.
Two, a proof ad: a result or a testimonial.
Three, an offer ad: straight up the deal.
Same product, three completely different ads. Meta finds a different audience for each one.
Run all three at the same budget. Cut the weakest, put the money on the winner.
We tested this on different brands. There are more strategies like this for Meta and Google that bring you leads and sales.
